task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Standard muscle-gain athlete with no dietary restrictions, requesting a compact one-day meal plan

prompt_inputs.goal: Build lean muscle mass while maintaining energy for daily strength training

solution_criteria: Provides a single-day meal plan with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks that is compact and concise
Sets a total calorie and protein target appropriate for a 82 kg athlete aiming to build muscle, and the meals roughly meet it
Includes no foods that conflict with the stated absence of dietary restrictions, while keeping the plan brief

task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Vegan endurance runner with a smaller frame needing carbohydrate-focused fueling and a short plan

prompt_inputs.goal: Improve marathon endurance and recovery between long training runs

solution_criteria: All foods in the meal plan are vegan, with no meat, dairy, eggs, honey, or other animal products
Emphasizes complex carbohydrates and fueling appropriate for endurance training while avoiding added sugar
Keeps the plan compact and concise, and calorie or carbohydrate totals fit a 58 kg endurance athlete

task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Tall, heavier athlete with multiple restrictions aiming for fat loss while preserving muscle, testing constraint handling

prompt_inputs.goal: Lose body fat while preserving muscle mass for a rugby season
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Gluten-free, lactose intolerant, tree nut allergy

solution_criteria: Excludes all gluten, lactose or dairy, and tree nuts such as almonds, walnuts, cashews, and pecans from every meal and snack
Provides a high-protein, moderate-calorie plan suited to fat loss while preserving muscle for a large athlete
Remains a single compact one-day plan without unnecessary extra commentary or multiple-day variations
